sources.query: SELECT CCID, PERIOD_NUM, SET_OF_BOOKS_ID, PERIOD_YEAR, JE_SOURCE, JE_CATEGORY, FUND_VALUE, ACCOUNT_NUMBER, AUTHORITY_TYPE_CODE, FED_NON_FED, TRADING_PARTNER_TYPE, TRADING_PARTNER_NAME, TRADING_PARTNER_AGENCY_ID, TRADING_PARTNER_MAIN_ACCOUNT, BUDGET_IMPACT_IND, D_C_INDICATOR, AMOUNT, JE_HEADER_ID, JE_LINE_NUM, RECORD_CATEGORY, GL_PERIOD, BALANCE_TYPE, TRADING_PARTNER_ID, PERIOD_NAME, EXCEPTION_CATEGORY, DOLLAR_AMOUNT, REDUCTION_TYPE_CODE, DACT_REPORT_IND, PIID, PARENT_AWARD_ID, FAIN, URI, DOC_NUM, POSTED_DATE, DEFAULT_EFFECTIVE_DATE, AE_HEADER_ID, AE_LINE_NUM, INTEGRATION_ID, CREATED_ON_DT, DATASOURCE_NUM_ID, PROVIDER_RECIPNT_ID, PROVIDER_RECIPNT_NAME, EVENT_ID FROM W_GTAS_ACTIVITY_BALANCES_FS

SELECT s.CCID, s.PERIOD_NUM, s.SET_OF_BOOKS_ID, s.PERIOD_YEAR, s.JE_SOURCE, s.JE_CATEGORY, s.FUND_VALUE, s.ACCOUNT_NUMBER, s.AUTHORITY_TYPE_CODE, s.FED_NON_FED, s.TRADING_PARTNER_TYPE, s.TRADING_PARTNER_NAME, s.TRADING_PARTNER_AGENCY_ID, s.TRADING_PARTNER_MAIN_ACCOUNT, s.BUDGET_IMPACT_IND, s.D_C_INDICATOR, s.AMOUNT, s.JE_HEADER_ID, s.JE_LINE_NUM, s.RECORD_CATEGORY, s.GL_PERIOD, s.BALANCE_TYPE, s.TRADING_PARTNER_ID, s.PERIOD_NAME, s.EXCEPTION_CATEGORY, s.DOLLAR_AMOUNT, s.REDUCTION_TYPE_CODE, s.DACT_REPORT_IND, s.PIID, s.PARENT_AWARD_ID, s.FAIN, s.URI, s.DOC_NUM, s.POSTED_DATE, s.DEFAULT_EFFECTIVE_DATE, s.AE_HEADER_ID, s.AE_LINE_NUM, CAST(NULL AS VARCHAR2(250)) AS INTEGRATION_ID, s.CREATION_DATE AS CREATED_ON_DT, CAST(NULL AS NUMBER) AS DATASOURCE_NUM_ID, s.PARENT_AWARD_ID AS PROVIDER_RECIPNT_ID, CASE WHEN LENGTH(s.PARENT_AWARD_ID) = 7 AND SUBSTR(s.PARENT_AWARD_ID,1,3) <> '075' THEN (SELECT MIN(f1.DESCRIPTION) FROM FND_FLEX_VALUES_VL f1 WHERE f1.VALUE_CATEGORY = 'HHS_TP_ELIMINATION_CODE' AND f1.FLEX_VALUE = SUBSTR(s.PARENT_AWARD_ID,2,2)) WHEN SUBSTR(s.PARENT_AWARD_ID,1,3) = '075' THEN (SELECT MIN(d.OPDIV) FROM W_GTAS_INTRAHHS_D d WHERE d.TP_MAIN_ACT = SUBSTR(s.PARENT_AWARD_ID,4,4)) ELSE (SELECT MIN(f2.DESCRIPTION) FROM FND_FLEX_VALUES_VL f2 WHERE f2.VALUE_CATEGORY = 'HHS_TP_ELIMINATION_CODE' AND f2.FLEX_VALUE = s.PARENT_AWARD_ID) END AS PROVIDER_RECIPNT_NAME, s.EVENT_ID FROM FV_GTAS_ACTIVITY_BALANCES s

_notes: RESOLVED (run 330171, container DevContainer id 518): engineName=168_AN, folderName=Dataflow (deliberately NOT WorkingSession -- a pre-existing, differently-shaped dataflow named HHS_SDE_ORA_GTASActivityBalanceFact_TestCase already lives in DevContainer/WorkingSession, and dataflow names must be unique per container regardless of folder, hence the _v2 suffix on dataflowName here), dataSourceName JDBC_1=W_GTAS_ACTIVITY_BALANCES_FS, JDBC_2=FV_GTAS_ACTIVITY_BALANCES. Deployed dataflow GUID c094116a-4687-4eb3-968f-50062281a005.

JDBC 2's ':LAST_EXTRACT_DATE' WHERE clause was removed before running -- that bind syntax is not valid on this platform and no resolvable value was known, so run 330171 is a full-table comparison of JDBC_2 against JDBC_1, not an incremental one. The 1 only-in-source row found (CCID=10010) is consistent with this: it is plausibly just outside the real $$LAST_EXTRACT_DATE cutoff that the actual incremental load uses, not necessarily a defect.

Added CAST(NULL AS NUMBER) AS DATASOURCE_NUM_ID to JDBC 2's SELECT list (previously columnMappings referenced this column but the query never produced it, which would have failed at run time). Still ignoreColumn: true and NULL by design -- driven by the unresolved $$DATASOURCE_NUM_ID mapping variable at runtime, not by source data.

CONFIRMED FINDING (run 330171): INTEGRATION_ID is NOT actually NULL in the live target -- it holds real values shaped '<JE_HEADER_ID>~<JE_LINE_NUM>' (e.g. '5001~1'). All 9 matched rows mismatched on this column (NULL from this test case's JDBC_2 side vs the real pattern on the JDBC_1/target side). This proves the workflow XML's EXP_GTASACTIVITY.out_INTEGRATION_ID EXPRESSION attribute is incomplete/stale in the export, not that the mapping genuinely nulls this column. Do not silently patch this test case's expected value to match -- flag the XML gap for the user to reconcile against the real deployed mapping.

CONFIRMED FINDING (run 330171): PROVIDER_RECIPNT_ID (8/9 mismatches) and PROVIDER_RECIPNT_NAME (6/9 mismatches) do NOT match a simple PARENT_AWARD_ID passthrough/lookup in the live target -- e.g. target PROVIDER_RECIPNT_ID values like '1200','1400','0751234' and resolved names like 'DEPARTMENT OF ENERGY','CDC','FDA' do not correspond to this test case's PARENT_AWARD_ID-based CASE logic (which the XML's LKP_PROVD_RECP/LKP_INTRA_HHS_ELI lookups describe). This matches the pattern of a richer TRADING_PARTNER_TYPE-keyed lookup already present in a different, pre-existing dataflow (HHS_SDE_ORA_GTASActivityBalanceFact_TestCase in DevContainer/WorkingSession) that an earlier review found did not match the current XML -- this run empirically confirms that older dataflow's logic reflects production reality better than the currently committed workflow XML does. Genuine XML-vs-production discrepancy; do not patch around it here, see OKF Known Caveats.

Row CCID=10009 has blank TRADING_PARTNER_TYPE/PARENT_AWARD_ID on both sides, so no PROVIDER_RECIPNT_ID/NAME mismatch is flagged for it -- only INTEGRATION_ID mismatches, consistent with the finding above.
All other 38 columns (full passthrough set) matched perfectly across all 9 matched rows in run 330171 -- passthrough logic is empirically validated correct.

The 9-column composite key (CCID, PERIOD_NUM, SET_OF_BOOKS_ID, JE_HEADER_ID, JE_LINE_NUM, AE_HEADER_ID, AE_LINE_NUM, BALANCE_TYPE, RECORD_CATEGORY) is inferred from the fact's grain -- no target field in the workflow XML declares a KEYTYPE other than 'NOT A KEY'. Prefer the real target table PK/unique constraint if it can be confirmed against W_GTAS_ACTIVITY_BALANCES_FS.
